title: 正文 第三章 身份暴露
lines: 规则之眼布下的封印犹如天威，捆缚了一切。整个世界都变得灰黑一片，被枯寂和腐败占据，充满了死亡与杀戮。唯有昏黄的漩风，无休止的游荡在满目苍痍的大地上。
只不过这一次的旋风有些不同，昏黄的旋风中出现了一道道猩红的目光。
“这些旋风有些诡异，望之不穿，我只能大概感应到有十三头异兽。”乐萱皱着眉头，有些吃力。
“乐萱妹子你已经很厉害了，这里的风可不简单，乃是风生兽王的酣睡气息所化。具有隔绝灵识之力的作用，你的通灵仙体还太弱小自然感应不到。”徐辉讨好的说道，自从知道她是林雅的师妹，徐辉这一路上可没少献殷勤。
“不对，他们不是风生兽。”幻天眼眸流转紫色光芒，很是警惕。
“根据家族历来先辈的记载，这里是风生兽蛰伏之地没错啊！难道你——能——看——穿——这——旋——风。”徐辉正回忆家族留下来的信息，却看见幻天眼眸流转紫色光芒，目不转睛的盯着旋风深处，使得他下半句话打顿。其他人亦是如此，大张嘴巴，连可爱的乐萱也是如此，惊讶的说道：“你好厉害，比感识，你是第一个超越我的同境界之人。”
“防御战阵。”幻天忽略几人的惊讶表情，摆出几人事先说明的战斗方式，将乐萱护在了中央。
“你是如何看透风生兽王的酣睡气息的？据我了解，你们东皇家可没有这个能力，至少你这个境界还做不到。”小和尚怀疑，拿出了一个闪烁暗金光芒的金钵，护在了胸前。
“如果没有特殊本领，那几个老家伙如何能让我这个力轮第一重的子孙来到此地。”幻天随意忽悠。
“老家伙！幻兄果然也是性情中人。”徐辉重复幻天的话语，很是投机。
“不知幻兄是如何看出它们不是风声兽的。”苍岚提问。
“风生兽我也见过几只，可是我没见过长着鳞片的风生兽。”
“管他呢！先抓它几只再说。”徐辉跃跃欲试。
“徐兄霸气，风生兽速度奇快，皮毛坚韧。只要不将其震碎，得风之，须臾之间便会复活，你确定要在这里抓取它们。”苍岚打击。
“开个玩笑，苍兄那么认真干嘛！”
“破晓天尽。”幻天不理会几人的吵闹，施展他记忆中为数不多的幻氏秘法。双眸闪耀紫光，浩荡而去。如同穿云利箭，刺破昏黄的旋风，向着周围看去，寻找出路。
于此同时，以此地为中心，无数的外来之人和此地异种，都被这破入云霄的紫光所惊扰。幻天如同一个药引子，引起了一场人心风暴，触动了太多居心叵测的人们。
“什么？好强的秘法，竟然能在遗落之地引发如此异象，真不知道和幻兄你在一起是福还是祸。”几人目瞪口呆，再一次被幻天的行为所惊讶。
“走，去那边。”幻天首当其冲，带动几人离开。
“幻兄，不会搞错了吧！这边风生兽最多。”
“多就对了，如果我没有猜错，那边因该是另一只兽王的领域。而兽王领地意识极强，不想爆发兽王之战的话，这些风生兽不会追过去的。”
“吼吼吼……”吼声如雷，充满了暴虐。
似是发现了几人行走的方向，十几头风生兽彻底狂暴，向着几人扑击而去。其中最为强大的一头风生兽冲向了幻天，对于它们来说，幻天是特殊的，必须抢先杀死。
看着扑击过来的风生兽，幻天震动指掌，一掌切出，斩向风生兽前爪的关节处。两者砰然作响，强大的力量超出了幻天的想象，幻天被撞的连连后退。一双素手伸出，轻轻的抵住了他的后背。“幻大哥，你身受重伤，还是换我来吧！”
幻天点头，此时不是逞强的时候。
“变换阵型。”苍岚大喊一身。几人随之变换阵型，组成了一个常用的利箭阵。苍岚为首，徐辉和能忍小和尚分守两边，乐萱殿后。三角阵如同一柄利剑豁开风生兽的围攻，冲向幻天所指引的目的地。
苍岚直接舍去了手中重剑，整个人如同一头人形凶兽，每一击都是势大力沉，与之碰撞的风生兽无不翻滚飞出。左边的徐辉手持一柄利剑，被他舞动的密不透风，冲过来的风生兽，稍有迟疑便被他分解成为了一堆肉片。而右边的能忍小和尚惦着一个巨大的金钵，每颂一次佛号重击一次，手下丝毫不见仁慈之色。
content_zh:
受伤越重，反弹越大，一股股旺盛如同汪洋般的生命之力被幻天吸收，修复着受创的躯体。

    生命源泉不愧为疗伤圣药，只是片刻幻天受损的躯体，破碎的骨骼就得以复原，并且更甚之前。

    力轮、换血、开脉、神庭、天问、法源……

    修者如沙，数之不尽，唯有跨入‘力轮’才算是进入修者的门槛，它似一道天堑，阻拦了太多胸有抱负的修者。

    力轮，一旦晋升入这一境界，将超越平凡。它是修行的第一步，也是最为重要的一步。九层之台，累于基土，根基越牢，以后的成就自然也就越高。

    幻天只记得八岁以前的记忆，他的修为同他的记忆一样，停留在了八岁以前，力轮第一重。

    力轮分四极，一极一蜕变，主要以打开肉身潜能为主。每打开一极将晋升一重。四极分别为双手的太渊穴和双脚的昆仑穴。

    幻天盘膝而坐，四肢沟通天地，左手的太渊穴绽放耀眼光芒，这是他现在的境界，力轮第一重。

    绚烂的霞光千万重，围绕着生命源泉飞舞。修复完伤势后，幻天开始吞噬庞大的生命精气，冲击现有的境界。生命精气至四肢百骸进入体内，幻天引导其进入右手的太渊穴。

    幻天乃是皇室之人，肉身潜能强过普通人数倍，本来以为没了皇室血脉，会跟普通人一样较容易踏入力轮第二重。不料太渊穴如同一个黑洞，源源不绝的吞噬着如同汪洋一般的生命精气，突破力轮第二重的难度不减反曾。

    如此庞大的生命精气至百脉流入，撑的幻天身形欲爆，百脉刚刚撑裂便被强大的生命力修复。如此往返，幻天承受着莫大的痛苦，不过好处显而易见，在毁灭与重生之间，幻天的经脉得以开阔，肉身被锤炼，整个人得到了改天换地般的升华。

    良久之后，绚烂的霞光消失，生命源泉归于平静。三尺见方的生命源泉减少了一层，幻天盘膝而坐，正好齐胸。望着眼前深闭眼眸的赤蛇，幻天在考虑要不要将其杀死。

    突然，‘啵’的一声脆响传来，接着是第二声、第三声……

    无数的啵啵之声传来，声音虽小，但听在幻天耳朵里犹如雷霆。幻天惊悚，可是已来不及阻挡。只是片刻，赤蛇如同水晶般的鳞片脱落殆尽。雪白的肌肉蠕动，在强大的生命精气滋润下，开始蜕变化形。

    兽类修行有三，一为潜修；二为进阶；三为蜕变。其中可蜕变着莫不是罕见稀少的荒古异种。

    烟霞氤氲，生命之光澎湃，一具妖娆多姿的躯体幻化。肌肤若羊脂白玉，其纹理光滑细腻，透着淡淡的光辉。

    似感受到幻天火热的目光，赤蛇突然睁开了眼眸，站了起来。妙曼身姿圆润修长，如瀑般的长发披散，遮挡胸前后背，傲人的双峰间两点嫣红若隐若现。

    赤蛇如秋水般的眸子一丝红光闪现，透着炙烈杀机，虽然闪瞬而逝，仍是惊动了此地的白骨巨兽。

    轰！

    白骨巨兽的灵魂之火突然变得炙热起来，超越之前千百倍，如同一轮蓝色的大日，耀眼灼目。

    巨大的威压如同惶惶天威，整个白骨之地都沉落了数尺。赤蛇也受得了牵连，圆润的双腿颤抖，骨裂之声咔嚓作响，同幻天一起跌落至生命源泉之中，溅起了数朵浪花。

    紧急时刻，幻天别无他法，哪管对方是蛇是人，一把将其温润滑腻的躯体揽入怀中。对于幻天的行为，赤蛇反抗，不过随之而来的一种奇特韵律使它放弃了抵抗。

    “混沌之光，化万物之始，转而阴阳。以我玄功，逆之——玄天变。”曾经的幻天为人所怨，除了哥哥，没有任何交谈之人，无聊之时便会来到皇室珍藏阁阅读典籍。而玄天变就是皇族珍藏的最高宝典之一。

    玄天变，以凡窃天，具有通天彻底之威能，为天所嫉。为了逃脱天道劫罚，玄天变第一变通的乃是变化之术。
content_en:
The more serious the injury, the greater the rebound. Waves of life force as strong as the ocean are absorbed by Huantian, repairing the injured body.

The source of life is worthy of being a holy medicine for healing. In just a moment, Huantian's damaged body and broken bones were restored, and even better than before.

Power wheel, blood exchange, pulse opening, divine court, heavenly questions, source of law...

Cultivators are like sand, countless in number. Only stepping into the Wheel of Power is the threshold to enter the cultivator. It is like a natural chasm, blocking too many aspiring cultivators.

The Power Wheel, once promoted to this realm, will transcend the ordinary.It is the first and most important step in spiritual practice.The nine-story platform is built on foundation soil. The stronger the foundation, the higher the future achievements will naturally be.

Huantian only remembers the memories before he was eight years old. His cultivation level is the same as his memory. He stayed at the first level of the force wheel before he was eight years old.

The force wheel is divided into four poles, each pole undergoes transformation, mainly focusing on opening up the potential of the physical body.Each time you open a pole, you will be promoted to one level.The four poles are Taiyuan point on the hands and Kunlun point on the feet.

Huantian sits cross-legged, his limbs communicating with heaven and earth, and the Taiyuan point on his left hand shines with dazzling light. This is his current state, the first level of the force wheel.

Thousands of brilliant rays of light dance around the source of life.After repairing his injuries, Huantian began to swallow up huge amounts of life essence, impacting his current realm.The life essence reaches the limbs and bones and enters the body, and Huantian guides it into the Taiyuan point on the right hand.

Huantian is a member of the royal family, and his physical potential is twice as strong as that of ordinary people. He originally thought that without the royal bloodline, it would be easier for him to step into the second level of the force wheel like ordinary people.Unexpectedly, Taiyuan Point is like a black hole, swallowing up life essence like a vast ocean, making it even more difficult to break through the second level of the force wheel.

Such a huge amount of life essence flowed into the Baimai, which stretched Huantian's body to the point of exploding. The Baimai was repaired by the powerful life force just after it burst.Going back and forth like this, Huantian suffered great pain, but the benefits were obvious. Between destruction and rebirth, Huantian's meridians were broadened, his body was tempered, and his whole person was sublimated as if the world had changed.

After a long time, the gorgeous glow disappeared, and the source of life returned to calm.The three-foot-square source of life was reduced by one layer, and Huantian sat cross-legged, just up to his chest.Looking at the red snake with its eyes deeply closed in front of him, Huantian was considering whether to kill it.

Suddenly, a crisp sound of "pop" came, followed by the second and third sounds...

Countless pops of pops came. Although the sound was small, it was like thunder in Huantian's ears.The fantasy world was terrifying, but it was too late to stop it.In just a moment, the red snake's crystal-like scales fell off.The snow-white muscles squirmed, nourished by the powerful life essence, and began to transform.

There are three types of animal cultivation, one is latent cultivation; the other is advancement; and the third is transformation.Among them, there are rare and rare ancient alien species that can be transformed.

The haze is misty, the light of life is surging, and a enchanting and colorful body is transformed.The skin is like mutton-fat white jade, with smooth and delicate texture and a faint brilliance.

As if feeling Huantian's fiery gaze, Red Snake suddenly opened his eyes and stood up.The graceful figure is round and slender, with waterfall-like long hair spread out, covering her chest, front and back, and two dots of bright red are looming between her proud breasts.

A trace of red light flashed in the red snake's autumn-like eyes, revealing a burning murderous intent. Although it passed away in an instant, it still alarmed the giant white-bone beast here.

boom!

The soul fire of the white-bone beast suddenly became hotter, a thousand times more powerful than before, like a blue sun, dazzling.

The huge pressure was like the terrifying power of heaven, and the entire Land of Bones sank several feet.Red Snake could also bear the implication, its round legs trembled, and the sound of cracking bones made a crackling sound. Together with Huantian, she fell into the source of life, splashing several waves.

At the critical moment, Huantian had no other choice. Regardless of whether the other person was a snake or a human, he took his warm and smooth body into his arms.Red Snake resisted Huantian's behavior, but a strange rhythm that followed made it give up its resistance.

"The light of chaos is the beginning of transformation of all things, turning into yin and yang. Use my mysterious power to reverse it - Xuantian Transformation." Huantian was once resented by others. Apart from his brother, he had no one to talk to. When he was bored, he would come to the Royal Collection Pavilion to read classics.Xuantianbian is one of the highest treasures collected by the royal family.

Xuantian changes, stealing the sky with mortals, possessing the power to reach the sky, and is jealous of the sky.In order to escape the punishment of heaven, the first thing Xuantian changed was the art of transformation.
